description: This file defines the View class for the ElasticSearch settings in the SuiteCRM administration module. It extends an abstract view class and handles configuration display and logging within the context of ElasticSearch integration.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A view class for handling ElasticSearch settings display in the SuiteCRM administration panel, extending the AbstractView class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the View object and sets the template path for rendering the view.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the display by checking ElasticSearch configuration, logging a warning if necessary, and assigning configuration to the template.
